info.title: Ringg AI Universal API
info.description: Manage Ringg AI assistants, calls, campaigns, and analytics

post.description: Creates an agent in Ringg AI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

introductionAndObjective.description: (Required) Introduction and objective of the agent

responseGuidelines.description: (Required) Guidelines for how the agent should respond

task.description: (Required) The task the agent should perform

sampleConversations.description: (Optional) Example conversations for the agent. Use \n for newlines between turns.

primaryLanguage.description: (Required) Primary language locale for the agent

secondaryLanguage.description: (Optional) Secondary language locale for the agent

voiceId.description: (Required) Internal AgentVoice ID (UUID). Get available voices from the Get Assistant Voices endpoint.

introMessage.description: (Required) Introduction message the agent will speak when the call starts

agentType.description: (Required) Type of agent. Defaults to outbound.

customVariables[].description: (Optional) Custom variables for the agent. For outbound agents, callee_name and mobile_number are always included automatically.

id.description: The unique ID of the created agent

version.description: The version slug of the agent

post.description: Initiates an individual outbound call in Ringg AI.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: The name of the person to call

mobileNumber.description: The phone number to call (must include country code, e.g., +91 for India)

agentId.description: UUID of the agent that will handle the call

fromNumber.description: The phone number to call from (with country code)

customArgsValues.description: Custom variables that will be replaced in the agent's prompt using @{{variable_name}} syntax

smartFormatter.description: (Optional) Smart formatting for callee name — supports first name extraction and dictionary-based transliteration

smartFormatter.extractFirstName.description: Extract the first actual name from the full name, skipping common prefixes (Mr, Mrs, Dr, etc.)

smartFormatter.transliteration.description: Transliterate the extracted name to the target language using a local dictionary. When enabled, extract_first_name is automatically applied.

callConfig.callRetryConfig.retryNotPicke.description: Minutes to wait if not picked (default: 30)

callStatus.description: The current status of the call

customArgsValues.description: Custom variables passed in the request
